name: upstash
description: Manage Upstash resources from the agent through the official @upstash/mcp-server — provision, scale, back up, and delete Upstash Redis databases; run Redis commands (strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, JSON, streams, pub/sub); create and query Upstash Vector indexes; publish, schedule, and inspect QStash messages and the DLQ; manage Upstash Workflow runs; spin up, snapshot, and clone Upstash Box sandboxes; and pull account and billing info.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Upstash Redis, Vector, QStash, Workflow, and Box through the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Upstash skill exposes the official `@upstash/mcp-server` (from the `upstash/mcp-server` GitHub repository) as a single Fractal toolset. It authenticates with the account email and an Upstash API key (read-only keys are supported and automatically disable every mutating tool) and surfaces the full Upstash console surface as MCP tools: Redis database lifecycle and per-database data primitives, Upstash Vector index management and similarity search, QStash publish / schedule / logs / DLQ, Upstash Workflow run lifecycle, Upstash Box sandbox lifecycle with snapshot + fan-out cloning, and account / billing introspection. A separate Box API key unlocks the Box tools.
defaultPrompt: Use the Upstash skill whenever the task involves provisioning, scaling, backing up, or inspecting an Upstash Redis database; running Redis commands; managing an Upstash Vector index or running a vector search; publishing, scheduling, or debugging QStash messages and webhooks; managing Upstash Workflow runs; or spinning up, snapshotting, or cloning an Upstash Box sandbox.
Prefer a read-only Upstash API key for read-only tasks — the server automatically disables every mutating tool when started with one.

Confirm before any irreversible Upstash op (`redis_delete_database`, `vector_delete_index`, `vector_reset`, `qstash_delete_schedule`, `workflow_cancel_run`, `box_delete`) — they are not reversible and are billable.
